parsed.summary: The change correctly handles the case where `__all__` is empty, but it may introduce a behavioral regression for cases where `__all__` is `None`.

issues.description: The change modifies the behavior when `__all__` is `None`. Previously, it would document all members, but now it will treat `None` as if `__all__` were empty, which may break existing behavior.
